selectedFunctions.label: Bean Exchange addLiquidity
warnings: Static exact-deployment source/ABI inventory only, not fresh RPC, storage, runtime identity, liquidity, successful execution or financial-safety attestation. Exact-function grants, canonical calldata/value checks, pauses, balances, allowances and independent controls remain mandatory.

Monad mainnet chain143 native currency is MON, not ETH. Constructor binds factory 0x8Bb9727Ca742C146563DccBAFb9308A234e1d242 and WMON 0x3bd359C1119dA7DA1D913d1C4D2B7c461115433A. Native input uses msg.value; nonpayable calls require zero native value. Token amounts use each token's raw decimals; bin liquidity amounts are per-bin LB share units.

Paths are explicit pairBinSteps and tokenPath arrays. Router obtains each pair from its immutable factory and invokes fixed swap(bool,address); no arbitrary target/calldata, permit, multicall or executor admitted. Factory-selected pair implementations and configurable hooks/fees are external dependencies, not caller-controlled executor payloads.

ERC20 inputs require allowance to this router. Removal burns msg.sender's per-bin positions and requires existing pair approveForAll(router,true), sufficient unlocked balances and matching ids/amounts. Authorization changes themselves are excluded. LP recipient and refundTo are independent; excess native liquidity is refunded as WMON by pair mint, not automatically native MON.

LiquidityParameters includes lockUntil: adding liquidity can lock the recipient's entire existing position in affected bins until a later timestamp. Locked shares cannot burn or transfer; source lock extension applies only when later than stored lock. Distribution entries are cast to uint64 before encoding and validated downstream; callers must choose coherent token ordering, bins, distributions, activeIdDesired/idSlippage, minimums, recipient and deadline. No minimum minted-LP-share argument exists.

Swaps enforce deadlines and min-output or max-input. Exact-output calculation narrows requested intermediate amounts to uint128; oversized inputs can truncate before downstream checks and are not automatically financially validated. Native exact-output refunds unused msg.value to caller, which must accept MON. Native recipients must accept empty-calldata transfers.

Fee-supporting exact-input swaps measure recipient output balance deltas (or router WMON delta for native output), not whole pre-existing router balance. Standard swap/minimum and liquidity removal checks use reported gross amounts and do not guarantee net fee-on-transfer receipts. removeLiquidityNATIVE explicitly does not support transfer-tax tokens. Dynamic swap/composition fees, integer rounding and factory-configurable pair hooks can affect output or revert calls.

Official current homepage links the live spot product and current docs describe DLMM/DAMM spot trading. Deployment source comes from Monad-documented BlockVision Sourcify service with exact creation/runtime matches; central Sourcify404 and MonadScan unverified do not replace this binding. Router is direct nonproxy; no current pool configuration or hook storage read is claimed. No caller KYC/role gate is present in reviewed ordinary router entries; interface/legal eligibility is not attested.

ERC20 inputs require allowance to this router. Removal burns msg.sender's per-bin positions and requires existing pair approveForAll(router,true), sufficient unlocked balances and matching ids/amounts. Authorization changes themselves are excluded. LP recipient and refundTo are independent; excess native liquidity is refunded as WMON by pair mint, not automatically native MON.

LiquidityParameters includes lockUntil: adding liquidity can lock the recipient's entire existing position in affected bins until a later timestamp. Locked shares cannot burn or transfer; source lock extension applies only when later than stored lock. Distribution entries are cast to uint64 before encoding and validated downstream; callers must choose coherent token ordering, bins, distributions, activeIdDesired/idSlippage, minimums, recipient and deadline. No minimum minted-LP-share argument exists.

Swaps enforce deadlines and min-output or max-input. Exact-output calculation narrows requested intermediate amounts to uint128; oversized inputs can truncate before downstream checks and are not automatically financially validated. Native exact-output refunds unused msg.value to caller, which must accept MON. Native recipients must accept empty-calldata transfers.

Fee-supporting exact-input swaps measure recipient output balance deltas (or router WMON delta for native output), not whole pre-existing router balance. Standard swap/minimum and liquidity removal checks use reported gross amounts and do not guarantee net fee-on-transfer receipts. removeLiquidityNATIVE explicitly does not support transfer-tax tokens. Dynamic swap/composition fees, integer rounding and factory-configurable pair hooks can affect output or revert calls.

sourceSemantics.pathBinding: Path is (uint256[] pairBinSteps,address[] tokenPath); lengths must be >=one hop and token count=hops+1. Each pair resolved through immutable factory getLBPairInformation; fixed swap(bool,address) calls, no user calldata.
sourceSemantics.liquidity: Exact deployed LiquidityParameters includes lockUntil after deadline. Router transfers raw caller token inputs directly to pair; pair mint pays excess underlying to refundTo (including WMON). Price/bin guards and per-token amounts apply, not minLP-share output. Pair burn debits msg.sender through router and existing per-bin operator approval.
sourceSemantics.locks: Bundled LBPair/LBTokenUpgrade source mint calls _setPositionLock for positive lockUntil. Cannot reduce existing active lock; positive timestamp must be future; locks block transfers/burns of entire account/bin balance. lockUntil0 does not clear existing lock. Pool implementation/current config not attested by router-source snapshot alone.
sourceSemantics.feesAndDependencies: Dynamic pair swap/composition fee and configurable before/after hooks; reported total-fee bound in bundled pair source is10%. Pair source included in router verification compilation is dependency semantics, not a claim that every current pool is identical.
sourceSemantics.exactOutput: _getAmountsIn narrows intermediate amountOut to uint128. Router enforces outer min-output/max-input after execution; no automatic financial sizing validation added.
sourceSemantics.claimsExcluded: collectFees/collectRewards pair source accounts supplied recipient; collectFeesNATIVE substitutes router recipient, not caller. Ancillary claims excluded from bounded swap/liquidity admission. depositVault caller-selected approval target excluded.
sourceSemantics.authority: No ordinary router role/whitelist check; factory-owner sweeps excluded. Native output/refund uses empty-calldata transfer to intended recipient/caller.
